title: CreatePipelineTransactionalOutputRequest
description: One Output of the single-call POST /api/pipelines request (HEL-906 task 3.1). `nodeStepClientId` resolves against a `steps[].clientId` in the same request; absent means the pipeline's raw source (root-bound). `rootClientId` (HEL-913 task 7.3a-i, R13) names WHICH `roots[]` element a root-bound Output attaches to, required (and validated) only when the request carries more than one root -- meaningless alongside a non-absent `nodeStepClientId`.

config.description: Output config. `compare` (HEL-1273) selects the history comparison: absent/null (none), `previous_run`, `1d`, `7d`, `30d`, or `custom:<d>` where <d> is a positive ISO-8601 duration in days/hours/minutes/seconds (PnDTnHnMnS, at most 365 days; week/month/year and lowercase/signed forms are rejected). Anything else is a 400. `historyPayloads` (HEL-1276) opts this Output's node into storing each real run's full row payload (boolean, default off; absent/null/false store none): kept only for beta (10 runs / 7 days) and owner (30 runs / 30 days) pipeline owners, never for free, and a node over 1000 rows or 1 MiB stores none. Any non-boolean is a 400.
